artifact.summary: Abstained: the specification does not define the simplex-of-K_M graph (adjacency and vertex count N), the marked-vertex configurations, the jumping rate gamma, or the evolution time. Without these, a faithful gate-level circuit for exp(-iHt) cannot be built without inventing the graph and parameters. A dense unitary and exact diagonalization are also disallowed.

equation_mapping.explanation: The search Hamiltonian H = -gamma*A - sum_w |w><w| depends on the adjacency matrix A of the simplex of K_M graphs and on explicit marked-vertex sets. The specification gives neither. Its form is also an assumed convention, not taken from the abstract. Implementing it would need an invented graph and a Trotter or other decomposition not given in the specification.

The evolution e^{-iHt} requires a defined H, gamma and t, and the critical gamma values per configuration are missing. The uniform initial state would be prepared by the runner, not by this operation, so no circuit is produced.

specification_changes.change: No implementation was produced; the construction is not scoped to a concrete circuit.
specification_changes.reason: The graph structure, vertex count and encoding into at most 12 qubits, marked-vertex configurations, gamma and t are unspecified, so any circuit would rest on fabricated details.

unresolved_issues: Adjacency structure of the simplex of K_M complete graphs and the vertex count N are not specified.
The marked-vertex configurations (two, M+1, 2(M+1)) are not specified beyond their counts.
The critical jumping rate gamma for each configuration and the evolution time t are not given.
The encoding of N vertices into at most 12 qubits, and a unitary-decomposition method for exp(-iHt) without dense matrices, are not given.
The Hamiltonian sign convention and oracle strength are assumptions, not content from the abstract.
